items.title: Louis Cottrell, Jr. Interview, 1961-08-25
items.q: Yeah, Jean Vigne, Mike Murray, D.D. Chandler, and my father, all of it was around the same period

ctx.x: Yeah, I can remember him. I was just where the Iberville Project is now, which was part of Storyville at the time. Well, he used to run a wooden cold yard, and he, and I know my daddy, and then they would have rehearsals sometime in the back of the cold yard some days when business would be slow and the guys would meet around there. And I can remember him from that area, going there, listening to them rehearsal. I was just about seven, six years old around the time I can recall. Very interesting. Yeah, Jean…
Yeah, I can't remember now. Wait a minute.
